CREATE TABLE public.preseason_tool (id UUID PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR NOT NULL, slug VARCHAR NOT NULL, is_verified BOOLEAN NOT NULL, "createdAt" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE public.preseason_category (id UUID PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR NOT NULL, "createdAt" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE public.preseason_season (id UUID PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR NOT NULL, "createdAt" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE public.preseason_model_snapshot (id UUID PRIMARY KEY, model_name VARCHAR NOT NULL, "createdAt" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE public.preseason_benchmark_run (id UUID PRIMARY KEY, status TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT preseason_benchmark_run_status_check CHECK (status IN ('scheduled', 'running', 'succeeded', 'failed')), scheduled_for DATE, "createdAt" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE public.preseason_match_config (id UUID PRIMARY KEY, tool_a_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.preseason_tool(id), tool_b_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.preseason_tool(id), category_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.preseason_category(id), is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, "createdAt" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE public.preseason_match_batch (id UUID PRIMARY KEY, config_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.preseason_match_config(id), benchmark_run_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.preseason_benchmark_run(id), season_id UUID NOT NULL, category_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.preseason_category(id), tool_a_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.preseason_tool(id), tool_b_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.preseason_tool(id), completed_evaluations INTEGER NOT NULL, "createdAt" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE public.preseason_match_evaluation (id UUID PRIMARY KEY, batch_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.preseason_match_batch(id), season_id UUID NOT NULL, model_snapshot_id UUID NOT NULL, presentation_order INTEGER NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT preseason_match_evaluation_status_check CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'presented', 'completed', 'skipped')), winner_decision public.winner_decision, winner_id UUID REFERENCES public.preseason_tool(id), "createdAt" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL)
